name: Thaumaturgy (Soul of the Serpent) — 3 Advanced — Form of the Hydra

system.description:
The ultimate expression of the path, this ritual allows the Warlock to explosively transform into a writhing mass of vipers — one snake for every blood point her body can hold — making her nearly impossible to destroy until every last serpent is located and slain.

System: The transformation costs two blood points and takes three turns to complete (during which the Thaumaturge can take no other action and shows no outward sign of the coming change), or five blood points to transform instantly. The Thaumaturge can reform from even a single surviving serpent, and remains in this state until she wills herself back to human form, a change that again takes three turns.
system.bloodCost: Two blood points (five for an instant change)
